description: “Space is an inspirational concept that allows you to dream big.” — Peter Diamandis
summary: TerraMatch is a website dedicated to exploring how space technologies, such as planetary rovers, can be developed and tested in places on Earth that share certain characteristics with the Moon and Mars. The website includes an interactive map showing potential analogue locations, image comparisons between Earth and other worlds, and information about the terrain and environmental conditions of each place. By combining maps, scientific research and interactive features, TerraMatch helps users discover less-explored locations on Earth and understand how studying these environments could be useful to preparing for future space missions.
details:
The website works by first allowing users to choose which planet they wish to compare Earth’s terrain against, either Mars or the Moon, before exploring the potential and underexplored analogue sites. The website has a multitude of separate sections, rather than one singular scrollable page, in order to avoid cramming the information. The categories include a main menu, introducing the project, its core purpose, and guiding users to select their target celestial body, our mission, details on our team, the project background, and the scientific datasets from NASA and partner space agencies, exploration, revealing the foundational profiles of the Moon and Mars, focusing on their environments and surface terrains before making direct comparisons, leading to the comparisons, site locations, and the mission use.

Benefits:

-Enlarging the range of possible testing areas: TerraMatch moves beyond the traditional, well-known analogue sites to uncover under-researched regions, as emphasised in the world map category.

-Helps identify potential unforeseen operational hazards: By having a more varied testbeds, this lets engineers identify and fix any possible hardware failures or terrain complications rather than facing emergencies in space.

-Potentially reducing mission costs: Providing the engineers and scientists with more accessible testing grounds in order to validate any equipment before funding for space launches. 

Development Tools and Technology Stack:

TerraMatch was developed using Framer to design and build the website, with React and TypeScript used to build the interactive features. AI tools helped us write and improve the code, troubleshoot issues and implement features like the interactive terrain map, locations on a map, and the comparison sections. OpenStreetMap was used to display the geographical locations of all the chosen Earth analogue sites. Our research used available geographic and scientific information on the Moon, Mars, and the selected locations on Earth. The project combines website design, interactive mapping and scientific research to make information about potential space analogue terrains accessible and engaging. 

Creativity and innovation:

The project includes a wide range of important planetary metrics (topography, surface temperature, water availability, etc.) combined with the evaluation of potential analogues, while creatively uncovering the less common testing environments. Rather than relying on common spreadsheets, the interactive aspects, such as our side-by-side image slider, allow users to explore complex comparisons with visual clarity and ease, making it a hands-on experience. This helps users understand information in more depth and engage meaningfully, ultimately creating a platform that encourages exploration and innovation.

Factors considered:

When creating this website, the following factors were considered:

-Design: A key factor that played a role in the success of this project was the design and usability of the website, particularly how users would navigate through the different sections and visualize the analogue locations.

-Understanding: Presenting complex information in a interactive way, rather than simply having users read about why these chosen testbeds have been picked, was important in making learning about space exploration more engaging.

-Responsiveness: The website was tested through an abundance of devices such as iPads, laptops, and phones to ensure that the functions of the website would provide a smooth experience.
